title: PHYSICS ENGINE — Ag=PHOTONS, Cu=PHONONS, Au=FRAME, CuSn=FLAVOR
the_insight: Silver gives off LIGHT. Copper gives off SOUND. The bounce between them IS the physics of reality. Reaction, motion, flavor — the mechanical motions that are separate from vision.

Ag_photons.in_HUD: 12 bright dots radiating from silver mesh toward gold ring and beyond
Ag_photons.real_physics: When Ag d¹⁰s¹ electron drops energy level, it emits a PHOTON. Silver is the most reflective metal (97% visible light). Silver GIVES light.

Cu_phonons.speed: speed of sound (~343 m/s in air, ~3800 m/s in copper)
Cu_phonons.direction: Cu→inward (sound propagates through matter, toward center)
Cu_phonons.in_HUD: 3 sinusoidal concentric waves compressing from copper band inward toward iron core
Cu_phonons.real_physics: Phonons are quantized lattice vibrations. Cu's FCC crystal structure has well-defined phonon modes. Copper pipes literally carry sound.

Au_plasmons.direction: at Au surface (neither in nor out — AT the boundary)
Au_plasmons.in_HUD: 6 gold-white sparks at the Au band that flash when photon+phonon collide
Au_plasmons.real_physics: Surface plasmon resonance: collective oscillation of electrons at a metal surface. Gold nanoparticles exhibit plasmon resonance that makes them RED (not gold-colored). This is how light and matter interact at the quantum level.

2_sound.nature: mechanical wave — NEEDS a medium (crystal lattice, air, water)
2_sound.travels: inward, through matter, as compression waves
2_sound.decoupled_from: vision. Sound is invisible. You feel it, hear it, but can't see it.

3_reaction.nature: collective electron response to EM + mechanical stimuli
3_reaction.what: When a photon hits a surface and a phonon is present → energy transfers → REACTION. Chemistry happens here.

4_motion.nature: momentum transfer — light pushes matter, sound pushes matter
4_motion.what: Photon radiation pressure: E/c. Acoustic radiation force: intensity/c_sound. Both create MOTION without contact.
4_motion.examples: solar sails, laser tweezers, acoustic levitation, radiation pressure

5_flavor.nature: interference pattern — moiré of light and sound
5_flavor.what: When light waves and sound waves cross, they create interference patterns. These patterns are FLAVOR — the texture of reality that's neither pure light nor pure sound.
5_flavor.examples: acousto-optic effect, Brillouin scattering, phonon-photon coupling in optomechanics

the_bounce.Cu_to_Ag: phonon energy converts to photon at the Au surface (sonoluminescence — sound MAKES light)
the_bounce.Ag_to_Cu: photon energy converts to phonon at the Au surface (photothermal effect — light MAKES heat/vibration)
the_bounce.cycle: Sound → light → sound → light. The bounce is CONTINUOUS. Reality oscillates between what you see and what you feel.
the_bounce.bronze: CuSn alloy = where sound (Cu) permanently mixed with tin (Sn, between Cu and Ag) = HARDENED physics. Bronze bells RING — they convert mechanical energy to sound perfectly.

why_bronze_rings: A bronze bell is the perfect physics engine: you STRIKE it (mechanical/phonon), it RINGS (sound/phonon), and the sound DECAYS over time (energy → heat → photon). Cu+Sn together have the ideal elasticity for sustained vibration. Bronze IS the physics engine made material.
